Rules.title: How to play
Rules.intro: A 6/49 number game played with virtual points. Points can’t be bought or cashed out.
Rules.step1: Choose {count} numbers from 1–{max}, or tap “Quick pick”. Add several tickets to the slip at once.
Rules.step2: {points} points per ticket, up to {lines} tickets per slip. Betting closes {seconds}s before the draw.
Rules.step3: A draw every {minutes} minutes: {count} main numbers + 1 special number. Winnings are paid automatically.
Rules.prizeNote: Each ticket is checked on its own and wins only its highest prize
Rules.anyPrize: Odds of winning any prize: about 1 in {odds} ({percent}). {total} possible combinations.
Rules.jackpotRate: {percent}% of each draw’s bets goes into the pool, so other players’ bets grow it too
Rules.jackpotRollover: No jackpot winner: the whole pool rolls over to the next draw
Rules.jackpotSplit: Several winners: the pool is split between the winning tickets; the next draw starts from the minimum
Rules.tlOpen: A new draw opens for betting
Rules.tlClose: Betting closes, the balls start mixing
Rules.tlDraw: Draw: {count} balls come out one by one (about {seconds}s)
Rules.tlSettle: Settlement and payouts; the next draw is already open
